section.text: Share project storage folders with project members

changes.oldText: First, log in with an admin account and create a project folder. After moving to the Data page, click Create Folder to open the folder creation dialog. Enter the folder name, set the Type to Project. When the type is set to Project, it will be automatically assigned to the project selected in the project selector in the header. Permission is set to Read-Only.
changes.newText: First, log in with an admin account and create a project folder. After moving to the admin Data page, click Create Folder to open the folder creation dialog. The dialog has no folder type selection — a banner states that folders created on this page are project folders — so choose the project that will own the folder in the Target Project field at the top of the dialog. Then enter the folder name and set Mount Permission to Read only.

changes.newText: Session ID: Narrow the list to a single session by its ID. The value must match the session's UUID exactly, so use it when you have an ID from a log entry or a support request and need the session it belongs to.
changes.newHtml: Session ID: Narrow the list to a single session by its ID. The value must match the session's UUID exactly, so use it when you have an ID from a log entry or a support request and need the session it belongs to.

changes.newText: The session list on this page also shows the Session ID column by default; hide it from the table's column settings if you do not need it.
changes.newHtml: The session list on this page also shows the Session ID column by default; hide it from the table's column settings if you do not need it.

changes.oldText: Click an agent's ID to open the Agent Info drawer, which shows the exact resource usage for that node. The drawer has two tabs: Resources, which breaks the usage down per resource slot, and Sessions, which lists the compute sessions assigned to this agent so you can see what is running on the node before stopping or restarting it. On the Sessions tab, use the Running / Finished selector to switch between sessions that still occupy the node's resources and sessions that have already finished, and click a session name to open its detail view on the Admin Session page.
